name: Umetsu Tatsumi
source:
He is the current president of the headquarters of Paris Dame.

He is devoted to his job as president, and is a skilled president for hire when it comes to stabilizing the company. He looks like a kind middle-aged man.

He is married to Reimi with an age difference, but he is happy with her.
